NUEVO LAREDO, Tamaulipas — The municipal government of Nuevo Laredo, through its Municipal Women’s Institute (INMUJER), is inviting the public to a talk on adult women and neurodivergence titled “Mujeres adultas y neurodivergencia: del reconocimiento al bienestar,” according to CML Noticias.

The talk will be led by Haydé Medina and is designed to open a space for understanding neurodivergence from a perspective of recognition and comprehension, helping participants expand their knowledge, identify their needs, and find tools to strengthen their personal well-being. The institute says the gathering aims to foster dialogue and reflection where women can explore new perspectives on their experiences, build self-awareness, and recognize the importance of self-care at different stages of life.

When and where

The talk is scheduled for Thursday, Oct. 29, from 5:00 to 7:00 p.m. at the Salón Palabra de Mujer, located at Orizaba #3829 in the Colonia México. Seating is limited, so attendees must register in advance through the registration form; more information is available by calling 867 713 52 81 or 867 719 21 60.

Sources:

  • CML Noticias: “Invita Gobierno Municipal a plática sobre neurodivergencia y bienestar en mujeres adultas” (Oct. 21, 2026)

title: Nuevo Laredo's women's institute invites women to Oct. 29 talk on adult neurodivergence
